title: Non-Holonomic Gradient Play: Leafwise Nash Equilibria, Stability, and Deception
summary: We study generalized learning dynamics in multi-agent systems whose joint state evolves on a manifold and whose agents act through state-dependent, potentially nonholonomic vector fields. Under a bundle-splitting condition, we show that these dynamics admit an intrinsic representation as projected Riemannian gradients, giving rise to a class of \emph{nonholonomic gradient play} dynamics. We characterize the local stability of its equilibria through an intrinsic linearization that explicitly captures the effects of the Riemannian connection and the nonholonomy of the actuation frame.
